no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Per FY2025 10-K, Liminatus is explicitly a 'pre-clinical stage biopharmaceutical company.' Lead asset IBA101 (humanized anti-CD47 monoclonal antibody, Hu3A5) has completed IND-enabling studies including a 4-week NHP toxicity study; the company is preparing the IND package and a Phase 1 monotherapy trial in advanced solid cancers (lung-focused, South Korea) is scheduled to initiate in 2026, with combination Phase 1 (IBA101 + durvalumab/pembrolizumab in NSCLC) targeted for 2027. The previously held GCC CAR-T license from Targeted Diagnostics & Therapeutics was terminated in August 2024. Company also has Nasdaq listing-compliance concerns (MVLS, MVPHS, and bid price all deficient as of late 2025/early 2026). No active P1/P2/P3 trials at snapshot date.
